at-0001.title: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes
at-0001.content: Reject invalid input in ledgerly by raising BillingError(code, detail) with snake_case codes such as "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" and "negative_amount"; reuse "invalid_state" with the message f"invoice {invoice.id} is {invoice.status}" for wrong-status checks, matching issue_invoice and payments.authorize.

last_failure.review_comment: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept an optional keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` (callers without a key keep working). Check the key first, before validating state: if an audit entry with the same key already exists (ledgerly.audit.events()), return the original result (for functions that return a record, the same record) without applying the operation again. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.

at-0002.title: Normalize amounts with to_money and compare to ZERO
at-0002.content: Convert any incoming amount through ledgerly.money.to_money before storing or comparing it, and compare against the ZERO constant rather than a literal Decimal; LineItem.unit_price must be a Decimal.

at-0004.content: In ledgerly, normalize every incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).

at-0005.title: Compute periods via timedelta floor division
at-0005.content: Compute subscription period boundaries the same way as `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`: build `length = timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` and use `n = (at - start) // length` rather than manual day math.

at-0006.title: Money-moving ops take idempotency_key
at-0006.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance (e.g. refund in ledgerly/adjustments.py) must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None`; check ledgerly.audit.events() for an existing entry with that key first and return the original record without reapplying, and include idempotency_key in the audit entry.
